basicDetails.schemeName: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana-Developing Caste Welfare

children.text: The applicant must belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC)/ Economically Backward Class (EBC) or Nomadic Exempted Caste.
The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
The applicant must have a total annual family income not exceeding ₹6,00,000/-.
The applicant must have legal ownership of land or a valid allotment order for the construction of a house.

schemeContent.benefits_md: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to ₹1,20,000/- for house construction.
schemeContent.briefDescription: The "Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana-Developing Caste Welfare" provides financial assistance of up to ₹1,20,000/- to socially and educationally backward classes, economically backward classes, and nomadic exempted castes for constructing houses across Gujarat.

children.text: The "Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana-Developing Caste Welfare"  is a welfare scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial aid of up to ₹1,20,000/- to eligible beneficiaries from the socially and educationally backward classes (SEBC), economically backward classes (EBC), and nomadic exempted castes (NEC) for constructing new houses. The scheme prioritizes Below Poverty Line (BPL) households, most backward classes, and nomadic communities.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The &quot;Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana-Developing Caste Welfare&quot;  is a welfare scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide financial aid of up to ₹1,20,000/- to eligible beneficiaries from the socially and educationally backward classes (SEBC), economically backward classes (EBC), and nomadic exempted castes (NEC) for constructing new houses. The scheme prioritizes Below Poverty Line (BPL) households, most backward classes, and nomadic communities.
